questions.prompt: The soldiers were bearing spears through the enemy line.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs hastīlia per aciem hostium ferēbant.

questions.prompt: We will bring gifts to the timid stranger.
questions.answer: Dōna peregrīnō timidō ferēmus.

questions.prompt: The sparrow bears a tiny twig to its nest.
questions.answer: Passer exiguum rāmum ad nīdum fert.

questions.prompt: They have borne heavy burdens across the fields.
questions.answer: Gravia onera per agrōs tulērunt.

questions.prompt: The wounded man is being carried out of the battle.
questions.answer: Vir vulnerātus ē bellō fertur.

questions.prompt: Rumors were being spread among the common crowd.
questions.answer: Fāmae per vulgus ferēbantur.

questions.prompt: The seeds will be carried by the wind of summer.
questions.answer: Sēmina ventō aestātis ferentur.

questions.prompt: Great praise was brought to the victorious leader.
questions.answer: Magna laus ductōrī victōrī lāta est.

questions.prompt: When we had brought help, the city was saved.
questions.answer: Cum auxilium tulissēmus, urbs servāta est.

questions.prompt: The general ordered that spears be borne to the walls.
questions.answer: Dux imperāvit ut hastīlia ad mūrōs ferrentur.

questions.prompt: So that he might bring water, the boy hurried to the river.
questions.answer: Ut aquam ferret, puer ad flūmen properāvit.

questions.prompt: I do not know what the stranger bears in his hands.
questions.answer: Nesciō quid peregrīnus manibus ferat.

questions.prompt: Bear these gifts to the temple, friends!
questions.answer: Ferte haec dōna ad templum, amīcī!

questions.prompt: Bring me the sword at once, boy!
questions.answer: Fer mihi gladium statim, puer!

questions.prompt: The poet is able to bear the songs of the muse.
questions.answer: Poēta carmina mūsae ferre potest.

questions.prompt: It is sweet to bear a light burden for a friend.
questions.answer: Dulce est leve onus prō amīcō ferre.

questions.prompt: The woman bearing water entered the doorway.
questions.answer: Fēmina aquam ferēns aditum intrāvit.

questions.prompt: The soldiers about to bring aid gathered at the gate.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs auxilium lātūrī ad portam convēnērunt.

questions.prompt: The gifts brought by the strangers pleased the king.
questions.answer: Dōna ā peregrīnīs lāta rēgī placuērunt.

questions.prompt: Bearing many wounds, the brave man fell.
questions.answer: Multa vulnera ferēns, vir fortis cecidit.

questions.prompt: If you had borne the standards, we would have conquered.
questions.answer: Sī signa tulissēs, vīcissēmus.

questions.prompt: The turtledove carries a tiny branch through the breezes.
questions.answer: Turtur exiguum rāmum per aurās fert.

questions.prompt: The waves will have carried the ship to the shore.
questions.answer: Undae nāvem ad lītus tulerint.

questions.prompt: The envoys bore the rumor of the war to the town.
questions.answer: Lēgātī fāmam bellī ad oppidum tulērunt.
